baseline.classification: Reproduced consumer compatibility gap; historical v1 input semantics must be preserved with an explicit new input version.

changes: Add explicit mastermind.hermes_memory_grounding_input.v2 with the same closed fields; select incumbent v_source_artifact_list only for that exact version.
Input v1 keeps historical distinct-digest semantics and remains compatible with Scenario v2 when its sources are unique. No automatic migration is inferred from a run label or duplicate values.
The retained-evidence builder permits input v2 only after binding to validated Scenario v2; input v2 with Scenario v1 refuses even when digests are distinct.
Exact source reference/digest membership, model visibility, hidden gold, raw-byte binding and original-effect vocabulary remain controlling.
Existing scorer-pass schema, scorer ID and six dimensions are preserved; input v2 uses scorer_version 2 in the existing configuration digest, while input v1 stays version 1.
Generic EVAL contracts, native producer, ArtifactStore, run validity and learning promotion owners are unchanged.
covered_journeys: Actual Runv3/Scenario v2 to existing score envelope and graph resolution with two authorized same-byte sources
Correct words with wrong authorized source or unlisted same-byte alias fail source identity
Unlisted/mismatched source pairs, hidden or nonvisible sources, duplicate or unsorted references refuse
Historical/new fixture and scenario version boundaries remain explicit
Unavailable model/session evidence, partial coverage, unknown effect and unproven cleanup remain invalid despite passing answer dimensions
Rehashed forged VALID is rejected by the incumbent graph verifier; missing output produces no score
Exact retained input/expected/output bytes, hidden expected answer and original unknown-effect reconciliation remain required
limits: All cases use synthetic producer facts; no live recall, real inference, learned skill, protected skill publication or measured efficacy is claimed.
Generic score graph verification binds the original run but does not recompute these custom dimensions. Exact raw artifacts and source-qualified scorer reruns remain necessary.
Source compatibility is not corpus enrollment, complete native producer evidence, an admitted production refinement lifecycle or installed acceptance.
Committed-head release and ownership gates are attributed to the resulting commit separately.
problem: The valid native Runv3/Scenario v2 source-identity contract permits distinct source references with identical bytes, but the existing grounding input v1 rejects duplicate digests. The compatibility defect is reproduced after successful existing run graph verification.
